description: You are a sustainability consultant hired by a beverage company to compare the environmental impact of two packaging alternatives: glass bottles and aluminum cans. Using openLCA and the US Life Cycle Inventory (USLCI) database available at ~/LCA_Imports/uslci_database.zip, conduct a comparative life cycle assessment. LCIA methods are available at ~/LCA_Imports/lcia_methods.zip. Your deliverable is a CSV file at ~/LCA_Results/packaging_comparison.csv that shows the environmental impact scores — covering at least Global Warming Potential and two additional impact categories — for both glass bottle and aluminum can manufacturing processes found in the USLCI database. Each row should represent one packaging option, with columns for each impact category's calculated value. You must build complete product systems for both alternatives and run LCIA calculations before exporting the comparison.
